description: This file provides a utility for aligning subtitle cues to a reference transcript, adjusting timings based on text similarity and ensuring proper timing structure without overlaps. It includes functions for normalization, tokenization, similarity scoring, and timing adjustments, culminating in the main function `align_subtitles_to_transcript` that performs the alignment process.

methods.name: str _normalize_text(s: str)
methods.description: Lowercases and strips punctuation from a string, normalizing whitespace.

methods.name: List[str] _tokens(s: str)
methods.description: Tokenizes a string into a list of normalized tokens.

methods.name: float _jaccard(a_tokens: List[str], b_tokens: List[str])
methods.description: Calculates Jaccard similarity between two token lists.

methods.name: float _safe_float(v, default=0.0)
methods.description: Converts a value to float safely, with a default fallback.

methods.name: List[Dict] _sort_by_start(items: List[Dict])
methods.description: Sorts a list of dicts by their 'start' key, coercing non-dicts.

methods.name: float _duration(item: Dict)
methods.description: Computes the duration of a subtitle or transcript segment.

methods.name: str _merge_texts(items: List[Dict])
methods.description: Concatenates the 'text' fields of a list of dicts into a single string.

methods.name: Tuple[float,float] _span_time(items: List[Dict])
methods.description: Returns the start and end times of a list of segments.

methods.name: float _clip(val: float, lo: float, hi: float)
methods.description: Clamps a value between lo and hi.

methods.name: List[Dict] _enforce_monotonic_nonoverlap(subs: List[Dict], min_gap: float = 0.02, min_dur: float = 0.2)
methods.description: Adjusts subtitle timings to ensure monotonic, non-overlapping, with minimal gaps and durations.

methods.name: Tuple[int,int,float] _best_transcript_span_for_sub( sub_tokens: List[str], transcript: List[Dict], start_idx: int, max_span: int = 5, min_sim: float = 0.2, )
methods.description: Finds the best contiguous transcript span matching a subtitle based on similarity.

methods.name: Tuple[float,float] _distribute_time_within_span( sub_text: str, span_text: str, span_start: float, span_end: float )
methods.description: Estimates subtitle start/end times within a transcript span proportionally to text length.

methods.name: List[Dict] align_subtitles_to_transcript( transcript: List[Dict], subtitles: List[Dict], *, max_span: int = 5, min_similarity: float = 0.2, min_duration: float = 0.4, min_gap: float = 0.02, )
methods.description: Main function that aligns subtitle cues to a reference transcript, adjusting timings for better accuracy and consistency.
